name: Proprietary Status And Reason 5
definition: Proprietary status and reason of an instruction or an instruction cancellation.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Proprietary identification of the status of the instruction.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Proprietary identification of the reason for the status.

AdditionalReasonInformation.name: Additional Reason Information
AdditionalReasonInformation.definition: Additional information about the processed instruction.

AdditionalReasonInformationRule.definition: The AdditionalReasonInformation element must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed.
